about: Delta channel transition: why the channel becomes a GTA 6 channel. GTA 6 launches Nov 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S (rockstargames.com/VI). Own graphics, Ming US_James, no music.

lines.text: GTA 6 is taking over Delta.
Here's why. GTA 6 is almost here.
GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026.
lines.say: GTA 6 launches November nineteenth. Twenty twenty six.

lines.text: On PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.
lines.say: On PlayStation five, and on Xbox Series X and S.

lines.text: That is the date on Rockstar's own website.
Until now, Delta covered games of every kind. You watched, and you stayed.
So from here on, GTA 6 comes first.
Here is what you get.
A new GTA 6 Short, every single day.
Hidden details in the trailers. Easter eggs. Trailer breakdowns.
Mysteries and theories, always labeled as theories.
And after launch, guides to help you play.
Now, my promise to you.
Every fact comes with a source.
A rumor is always called a rumor.
No leaks. If it leaked, we will not show it.
And nothing here is affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
Your old videos all stay up. Every video.
Same channel. New focus.
Subscribe, so you never miss a day.
Then comment below.
Which GTA 6 topic do you want first?
